[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas was born in 1663. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3337|James Glasgow]] and [[Glessie-1|Annapill (Glessie) Glasgow]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3077]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Thomas's 1663 St Cuthbert's index names James Glasgow and Anabell Glass, accounted as Annapill Glessie's household. The Thomas event fits the recurring James/Annapill Glessie household, with Anabell Glass retained as the indexed form.

Confident for the named record couple; literal spelling variants do not create another mother automatically.

Next useful test: Compare the parish image if the Glessie/Glass identification is disputed.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F316-L74 "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F316-L74 : 16 September 2021), Anabell Glass in entry for Thomas Glassgow, 1663.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Thomas Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Thomas Glasgow and Gyles Spence on 24 July 1679 at Carstairs.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 633/10 / 37; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
